title: chore: release polli 0.1.23
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Bumps `@pollinations/cli` to 0.1.23 so the release workflow publishes it
- Ships `polli sandbox create | list | kill | ssh-config` from #15656, which merged after 0.1.22 was published
- `polli login` now asks for the `machines` permission

gist.headline: Polli gets a sandbox key
gist.blurb: Polli 0.1.23 packs four sandbox commands: create, list, kill, and ssh-config. Login asks for the machines permission so the new tools can do their job.
gist.summary: The @pollinations/cli 0.1.23 release packages polli sandbox create, list, kill, and ssh-config, and updates polli login to request the machines permission.
gist.impact: CLI users get sandbox management and SSH configuration commands, with the required machines permission requested during login.
